candidates.file: Te Rewa Rewa Bridge, New Plymouth (14155038182).jpg
candidates.reason: Category Te Rewa Rewa Bridge, 2013 Exif date. Vivid colour photo of the whale-rib bridge on the walkway with snow-capped Taranaki framed under the arch, clear blue sky. Strong; slightly flatter than the best framing.

candidates.file: Te Rewa Rewa Bridge, New Plymouth (14177934443) (2).jpg
candidates.reason: Category Te Rewa Rewa Bridge, 2013 Exif. Best framing: whole rib arch, Taranaki centred in the arch, walkway leading in, deep blue sky, rich colour. Recognisable as the Coastal Walkway's signature bridge.

candidates.file: Te Rewa Rewa Bridge, New Plymouth (13971190950).jpg
candidates.reason: Category Te Rewa Rewa Bridge, 2013. Bridge pier and ribs with Taranaki at left, flax foreground, vivid colour. Good but the bridge dominates off-centre and the path is barely shown.

Category Te Rewa Rewa Bridge, 2010 Canon A650. Genuine photo of the bridge in side view, but no Taranaki and no sense of the walkway or setting; plain snapshot light and a foreground of bark mulch. Not spectacular.

Rock-lined walkway in grey stormy surf with Paritutu in the distance; real and the right place, but dim, murky blue cast, overcast and low-contrast. Moody rather than spectacular and unappealing as a card.

Category New Plymouth Coastal Walkway, 2008. Real photo of the walkway but a snapshot from a stair with rail line, car park, bins, people and handrail intruding under hazy cloud. Flat, not spectacular.
